app.name: Astralis
app.tagline: Astronomy-accurate astrology mapped to your real sky

landing.seoTitle: Astralis: Astrology Mapped to the Real Sky
landing.seoDescription: Astralis is astronomy-accurate astrology mapped to your birthplace, the moving sky, and calm premium chart interpretation inspired by Mongolia's vast night sky.
landing.heroTitle: Astrology mapped to the real sky.
landing.heroSubtitle: Astralis begins with real planetary positions, your birth time, and the sky above your birthplace, then turns that map into calm, emotionally precise guidance.

preview.note: Your private reading connects the moving sky to your calculated natal chart.

different.title: Less generic horoscope. More sky-aware interpretation.

real.title: Real planetary positions
real.body: Readings start from the actual sky for the day, including planetary placements, lunar context, and available transit signals.

birthplace.title: Birthplace-aware charting
birthplace.body: Your place of birth matters because the horizon and houses are local. Astralis treats location as part of the chart, not a formality.

calm.title: Calm premium interpretation
calm.body: The voice is precise, grounded, and emotionally intelligent, designed for reflection rather than urgency.

mongolia.title: Built beneath Mongolia's vast night sky
mongolia.body: Astralis carries a global, modern astrology experience inspired by open steppe skies and long attention to the heavens.

todaySky.title: The moving sky changes the tone of the day.
todaySky.body: Astralis explains the simple celestial context behind a daily reading before interpreting what it may touch in your chart.

sun.label: Sun sign
sun.body: The Sun marks the season's core emphasis and the kind of attention the day asks for.

moon.label: Moon sign
moon.body: The Moon moves quickly, shaping emotional rhythm, instinct, and the quieter texture of the day.

phase.label: Moon phase
phase.body: The lunar phase gives timing context, from beginning and building to release and integration.

transits.label: Transits
transits.body: When a moving planet closely meets your natal chart, Astralis can explain why today feels more specific.

birthplace.title: Your chart begins where the sky met the horizon.
birthplace.body: Latitude and longitude help determine the local horizon, angles, and house structure at birth. Astralis uses that context to keep your chart anchored to the actual sky without claiming astrology is scientifically proven.

sample.title: A calmer way to read the day
sample.body: Example only. A signed-in reading can use the current sky and your available chart fields.
sample.quote: With the Moon emphasizing reflection while the Sun steadies your daily rhythm, today may feel less like a push forward and more like a careful recalibration. Notice where your chart asks for precision before momentum.

mobilePreview.title: A personal sky map in a quiet daily ritual.

today.label: Today's sky
today.title: Sun, Moon, phase, transit
today.body: A compact card shows the real-sky context before the reading.

why.label: Why this reading?
why.title: Reason before interpretation
why.body: The app explains which sky signals shaped the guidance.

reveal.label: Chart reveal
reveal.title: Your birthplace anchor
reveal.body: Onboarding turns birth data into a visible sky-mapping moment.

origin.title: Inspired by the open steppe sky, built for a global audience.
origin.body: Astralis uses Mongolia as an origin point for tone and imagination, not a boundary. The product stays premium, modern, and globally usable while honoring the feeling of a vast, precise night sky.
